description: Figure 3 is a donut chart illustrating the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to large language models (LLMs) within WildChat conversations that were matched to published online articles from two identified news agencies. The chart is divided into nine distinct segments, each labeled with a stimulus type and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents “Draft/Other” at 26.4%. The second largest, in yellow, is “Press Release” at 18.7%, followed by “External News Article” in dark green at 18.1%. Other segments include “Interview” (8.8%, purple), “Event Posting” (6.6%, maroon), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, lavender), “Organizational Website” (4.9%, blue), “Intra-agency news article” (4.9%, teal), and “Email” (2.7%, light green). The smallest segment, in light yellow, is “Social Media Post” at 1.1%. The chart’s central label reads “Stimulus Type,” and each segment’s label and percentage are positioned radially outside the donut ring. The segments appear ordered roughly by decreasing size, starting from the top-right and moving clockwise.
